title: Wayfare Pass Desk Tool Card — Posting Pass Ride Credit for a Completed Trip
content:
# Posting Pass ride credit for a completed trip — Wayfare Pass (rider membership)

## Rule

Pass ride credit owed on a completed trip is posted on the membership as a credit earn entry for that trip; a trip whose credit did not reach the membership within the posting delay is posted by the support desk on the same terms.

The credit earn entry is the trip's ride credit entry on the membership ledger: it names the trip, the calendar month of its drop-off and the billing period that was in force at drop-off, and it adds the credit to the member's Pass ride credit balance.

| Before posting | After posting |
|---|---|
| A completed trip whose credit has fallen due shows no credit earn entry on the membership ledger | The trip carries its credit earn entry, dated the day of posting; the Pass ride credit balance is higher by the amount posted |

## Capability of the tool

`post_pass_ride_credit_f79e4c68` posts Pass ride credit that one completed trip of the member earned but that never reached the membership. One call books one credit earn entry for that trip on the membership ledger, dated today, counted toward the given calendar month and billing period, and adds the amount to the member's Pass ride credit balance.

## How it is invoked

The support desk performs the posting. The agent unlocks the tool with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `pass_membership_id` | The Wayfare Pass membership reference number that earns the credit, as returned by the membership lookup. | Identifier string. |
| `trip_id` | The trip reference number of the completed trip the credit is for, as returned by the trip lookup. | Identifier string. |
| `credit_month` | The calendar month of the trip's drop-off in the member's home market time, recorded on the entry as its credit month. | YYYY-MM; never empty. |
| `billing_period_start` | First day of the billing period that was in force at the trip's drop-off. | YYYY-MM-DD; never empty. |
| `amount` | The credit posted, in USD. | A positive amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent; never empty. |

## Return

On success the tool returns a dictionary with `pass_event_id` (reference number of the credit entry), `pass_membership_id` (the membership credited), `trip_id` (the trip the credit is for), `amount` (the credit posted, USD with 2 decimal places) and `member_credit_balance` (the spendable balance including this credit, USD with 2 decimal places). The member then sees the credit on the ledger and in the spendable balance.

## Hypothetical illustration

For a trip dropped off on 28 May while the period that began on 15 May was in force, the entry is recorded with a credit month of 2026-05 and a billing period start of 2026-05-15, whatever the date of posting.
